name: Open Agent Email Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 self-hosted email infrastructure for AI agents: inbound SMTP inboxes, REST/MCP APIs, signed webhooks, approval workflows, and SQLite/PostgreSQL storage; no vendor-imposed software usage quota or expiry.
watch_out: Free software only, not free hosted email. Production inbound mail requires a public server, domain/MX records and port 25 access; outbound mail requires a separately configured SMTP relay (potential charges). Secure keys, backups, deliverability and operational maintenance are the operator's responsibility.
